passages.text:
<line> MOLD?!?
<line> IN THE SAFE?!?
<line> .... am i....
<line> seeing things?
<line> ... the roach guns.. are they real?
[[the guns are real, the mold is real, and the manager is evil]]
[[it's not real. i'm actually going insane]]

<line> the mold must be why i'm seeing roaches with GUNS
